title: Quadratic Functions: y = a(x + p)² + q
seo_title: Grade 11 Quadratic Functions Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Revise the effect of the parameters a and q and investigate the effect of p on the graphs of the functions defined by y = f(x) = a(x + p)² + q; sketch graphs, find their equations and interpret graphs.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 11 quadratic functions worksheets: y = a(x + p)² + q, turning points, axes of symmetry, range, intercepts and equations. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • y = a(x + p)² + q has its turning point at (−p; q) and axis of symmetry x = −p.
  • a > 0: minimum, range y ≥ q. a < 0: maximum, range y ≤ q.
  • For y = ax² + bx + c, the turning point is at x = −b2a.
  • To find a, substitute the turning point and one more point.

Examples

Example

y = 2(x − 3)² − 8

TP (3; −8)

x-int: (x − 3)² = 4

Answer: x = 1 or x = 5

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
(p; q)The turning point is (−p; q).
The y-interceptSubstitute x = 0.
−b ÷ 2aKeep the minus sign.
